answer_1.quote: We evaluate a total of 15 data-to-text systems, comprising three rule-based systems and 12 neural systems, of which two are large language models (LLMs) without any training or fine-tuning.
answer_1.outputs: Word‑span annotations of semantic errors (omission, addition, repetition) in system output texts

answer_4.quote: We conducted a pilot experiment on a set of 10 triples/verbalisation pairs with 10 researchers from ADAPT Research Centre, Ireland. ... We used the brat annotation tool to record word‑span annotations of semantic errors (omission, addition, and repetition).
answer_4.guideline: The evaluator should check if each element in the input triples is verbalised (omission), if any content in the verbalisation does not correspond to an input element (addition), and if any content is repeated without a corresponding input repetition (repetition).
